newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Hanbo Engineering seeks court receivership.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Hanbo Engineering seeks court receivership.

text.p: South Korea's Hanbo Engineering and Construction Co, an unlisted unit of failed Hanbo Group, have filed for a court receivership, Korea First Bank said on Saturday.
An official at the bank, the company's prime creditor, said the troubled construction company filed with a Seoul court an application for receivership from its creditors late on Friday.
Hanbo officials were not available to comment.
Hanbo Engineering defaulted on 6.5 billion won worth of promissory notes which was due by the final deadline on Friday, the Korea First Bank official said.
Hanbo Engineering faced financial difficulties after the group's flagship Hanbo Steel Co collapsed in January under $5.8 billion of debts.
Korea First Bank earlier said it planned to seek a buyer for Hanbo Engineering after the court receivership.
